Name: Isla Reimagined
Author: AEscraed
Description:
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url]A complete set of sprites and portraits for PaperNautilus' [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6931]Custom NPC Isla[/url]﻿. The new looks are a bit different from the original vision, but I've tried my best to make them fit her personality, and, as of 2.0, kept the green hair and seashell hairpin. The seasonal outfits are purposefuly more varied than the original, also in hopes to better fit in with recommended mods. The sprites and portraits are quite detailed, and (I believe) fit in well with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] mod by Poltergeister.﻿

Currently, for the mod to work properly in all seasons, and get the extra Flower Dance sprites and portraits, you will also have to install the optional file. Since that one is and edited contents.json from the original Isla mod, and PaperNautilus has yet to respond to my message, I decided to keep it separate for easy removal in case the author decides against allowing sharing that file.

The sprites and portraits, however, where made from scratch, with the exception of Elysa and Soraya's portraits, which were made by editing Camila and Clare's portraits from [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] by Poltergeister (and a flower used in the summer outdoor portrait, also by Poltergeister).[/size]

[b][size=3]﻿Installation[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Download and install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6931]original Isla mod[/url];﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Download and install the main files from my mod. Overwrite the files from the original mod;[/size]
[*][size=3]Download and install the optional files from my mod (if you want maximum consistency!). Overwrite the files from the original mod.[/size]
[*][size=3]Enjoy![/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]Credits[/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]PaperNautilus[/b] for the original Isla - Custom NPC mod[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Poltergeister[/b] for Camila and Clare's portraits, base for Elysa and Soraya's. Also for the flower used in Isla's hat in her summer outdoor portrait.[/size]
[/list][/size]

Downloads.Description: All-in-one replacer for Isla, Kelpie, Elysa and Soraya sprites and portraits in CP format. NO overwrites necessary thanks to the manifest dependencies.
